name: Covert Ops - Alpha
summary: Alliance agents move against the Venture Company in the Stonetalon Mountains. Under Gaxim Rustfizzle, they enter the lumber mill in Windshear Crag to recover its engineering schematics.

sections.title: Sabotage and Espionage
sections.body: From Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle directs a covert effort against the Venture Company's aggressive logging. Goblin loggers cut timber south of Cragpool Lake. Destruction alone cannot stop them, so Plan Alpha sends agents past the loggers and overseers to take the mill's technical schematics.

sections.title: Reverse Engineering
sections.body: The Venture Company's schematics interest gnomes for more than the night elves' forests. They reveal how goblin loggers, mechanical cutters and mechanized transports work. Alliance engineers can study their structural flaws to break up future operations. They can also adapt goblin designs for their own projects in Ironforge.

faq.q: What is the primary goal of Covert Ops - Alpha?
faq.answer: Recover the Venture Company's engineering plans from its lumber mill in Windshear Crag, south of Cragpool Lake. Explosives are part of the wider covert effort, but success depends on bringing back the blueprints.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Covert Ops - Alpha?
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle, an Alliance gnome tinker in the Stonetalon Mountains, directs sabotage against goblin industry.

faq.q: Where are the engineering plans located?
aliases: where are the venture co plans
faq.answer: The Venture Company Engineering Plans are inside the operational lumber mill in Windshear Crag, south of Cragpool Lake, guarded by goblin loggers.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim Rustfizzle want the Venture Co. blueprints?
aliases: what will gaxim do with plans
faq.answer: Gaxim wants to study the structural weaknesses of goblin logging machines. Their flaws can guide more effective sabotage of future machinery, and their useful designs can improve Alliance devices.

faq.q: Is sheer destruction the point of the mission?
aliases: do i blow up the mill
faq.answer: No. Gaxim says success depends on recovering the schematics intact, not on how much destruction the agents cause.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance fighting the Venture Company here?
aliases: why fight venture company in stonetalon
faq.answer: The Venture Company cuts forests and pollutes the land in Stonetalon. Alliance agents disrupt its industry and protect strategic territory in Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a gnome tinker, you can study goblin plans, spot flaws in their designs and take their lucrative mechanical tricks.
The schematics reveal the Venture Company's gritty, high-combustion mechanisms and offer insight into industrial motor works.
As a night elf, you see the Venture Company's logging in Windshear Crag wound Stonetalon's ancient forests. Sabotaging its logging works is urgent.
As an Alliance member, you help secure footholds and curb industrial extraction across Kalimdor, maintaining tactical parity against rival powers pressing into contested wilderness.
